The '''Kamparas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamparas]].
